item.title: MISTER MIRACLE Showrunner Tom King Teases Imminent Casting Announcement And Pushing Boundaries Of Animation
item.description: Comic book writer Tom King has shared an exciting update on his upcoming adaptation of Mister Miracle, revealing that a casting announcement—with wider implications for the DCU—is imminent.

item.title: ABSOLUTE BATMAN: ARK M SPECIAL #1 Introduces A New Take On One Of The Dark Knight's Deadliest Foes - SPOILERS
item.description: DC Comics released the Absolute Batman: Ark M Special today, and as well as teeing up some deadly new foes for the Caped Crusader, the issue ends with a huge introduction...

item.title: Marvel's Stormbreakers Transform Our Favorite Heroes (And A Villain) Into Iconic Monsters
item.description: Marvel Comics has revealed new "Marvel Monster Variant Covers," the latest variant cover collection from the current Class of Marvel's Stormbreakers, heading to comic book stores this March.

item.title: SUPERGIRL: A New Look At Milly Alcock As The DCU's Woman Of Tomorrow Has Been Revealed
item.description: A new look at DC Studios' Supergirl has been revealed, putting the spotlight on Milly Alcock (House of the Dragon) suited up as the DCU's Woman of Tomorrow.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: All Four Teaser Trailers Ranked From Worst To Best
item.description: Marvel Studios has now released four teasers for Avengers: Doomsday, and with a fifth trailer not expected until the Super Bowl, we're ranking them from worst to best.

item.title: MCU Rumor Roundup: Updates On STRANGE ACADEMY, New JESSICA JONES Show, [SPOILER]'s DOOMSDAY Role, & More
item.description: Some rumored updates on a number of upcoming Marvel Studios projects here, including the planned Strange Academy series, a new Jessica Jones show, and more...

item.title: Disney's Live-Action TANGLED Finds Its Lead Stars In TITANS' Teagan Croft And ZOMBIES' Milo Manheim
item.description: Disney's long-awaited live-action Tangled reboot has finally found its leads, with Teagan Croft (Titans) and Milo Manheim (Zombies) set to play Rapunzel and Flynn Rider.
